_om_os: spor/omos: the About page (L61). Figures in these strings are ALWAYS placeholders — {n}, {muligt}, {io} — and are filled in by tools/skabelon/om-os.mjs at build time. Never write a number here; see D7/L30. KeyResearch's services must not be described, and there must be no link to the sales site.
om_beskrivelse: Who publishes the quadruped robot catalogue, how the figures are gathered and sourced, and what the site does not do.
om_lede: The catalogue describes {n} quadruped robots from {p} manufacturers in {l} countries. It is published by KeyResearch in Aarhus, Denmark. This page says where the figures come from, what they do not cover, and who stands behind them.
om_regnskab_broed: The schema has {felter} fields. With {n} robots in the catalogue there are {muligt} possible pieces of information. Every single one of them is accounted for here, and they add up.
om_regnskab_kilder: {k} of the {o} stated fields carry a source mark. {a} point to the manufacturer’s own product page, {b} to a datasheet, a manual or developer documentation on the manufacturer’s own domain. The remaining {r} are the answer no, which has no figure to source.
om_regnskab_note: The gaps are counted too. A field the manufacturer leaves empty says as much about the robot as a figure does — which is why it stands on the page instead of being hidden.
om_metode_titel: How a figure reaches the page
om_metode_1_broed: We fetch the manufacturer’s own page, datasheet or manual and keep the file as evidence, with its address and the date it was fetched.
om_metode_2_broed: The figure goes into one of the schema’s {felter} fields with a unit and a source. If the manufacturer does not state it, the field becomes not stated. It never becomes an estimate.
om_metode_3_broed: The validator reads the whole catalogue again and stops the build if a figure is missing a unit, a source or a date. If the manufacturer’s metric and imperial figures do not match, we never correct them quietly: either the build stops, or the disagreement stands on the page beside the figure.
om_metode_4_broed: The pages are generated afresh from the same files, and the build runs the validator first every time. That is why the site carries {u} figures without a source.
om_tilstande_broed: A figure, a zero, a no and a gap are four different things. They are made to look different on purpose, because that is where catalogue pages lie: a zero turns into an empty cell, and an empty cell turns into a zero. In this catalogue the manufacturers state {nul} measured zeros, and {nej} times they answer no outright.
om_tilstande_noegle: The key below is the catalogue’s own. It is not a drawing of the marks but the very marks the robot pages set — which is why it also carries a fifth state, for what can only be seen in a photo, and the two source marks A and B.
om_ikke_titel: What this site does not do
om_ikke_koeb: There is no buy button, no paid referral links and no price enquiry form in a catalogue entry. The links to the manufacturers’ own pages are sources, not referrals we are paid for.
om_ikke_spor: The site sets no cookies, loads nothing from third parties and does not measure who reads it. It works without JavaScript.
om_ikke_score: There is no rating from 1 to 5, no stars and no ranking. Such a score would be an editorial conclusion rewritten as a number, and it would require a published method with acceptance criteria. That method does not exist, so neither does the score.
om_udgiver_broed: The catalogue is published by KeyResearch in Aarhus, Denmark. KeyResearch stands as the publisher of the reference work. Not as the sender of an individual catalogue entry, and not as a party to any sale.
om_udgiver_ret: If a figure is wrong, or a manufacturer has updated a datasheet, write to us. A correction is traced back to the source and gets a new fetch date.

skala_uden_tal: {u} without a figure — included only when the row below is ticked
skala_ridser: The notches are the steps the filter uses without JavaScript.

The source mark still points to the manufacturer's own page, where the amount stands in its own currency. The {u} robots without a stated price stand as their own row; they are neither cheap nor expensive.
